traditionnel.title: Traditional French restaurant in Amiens
traditionnel.metaTitle: Traditional French restaurant in Amiens, home cooking | L'atelier
traditionnel.metaDescription: A traditional French restaurant in Amiens at 47 quai Saint-Maurice: cassoulet, calf's head with sauce gribiche, veal blanquette and homemade desserts. Weekday lunch, Friday and Saturday dinner.
traditionnel.lead: At 47 quai Saint-Maurice, L'atelier serves traditional French food: slow-cooked dishes, hand-made sauces and desserts that never go out of style.

sections.p: The cassoulet bakes slowly in the oven, the calf's head comes with a caper-studded sauce gribiche, the blanquette keeps its old-fashioned cream sauce. Nothing complicated: good produce and as much time as it takes.
It's the dish our guests mention most. Melting beans, duck confit, sausage and pork belly: a generous plate, to share or not.
The restaurant sits on quai Saint-Maurice, a few minutes' walk from the Saint-Leu quarter. A small, warm room of about thirty seats, where people come back as regulars.
Lunch Tuesday to Friday, with the set lunch and dish of the day. Dinner on Friday and Saturday, à la carte. Booking advised.
